clips.title: The story
paras: South of Dolanaar, Lake Al'Ameth's shores have turned perilous as the local plant life grows violent. Once a quiet haven with little more than a wooden jetty, the lake is one of Teldrassil's largest freshwater bodies.

At Lake Al'Ameth, swarms of timberlings and timberling sprouts prowl the water's edge. The lake lies just south of Dolanaar, where its calm waters and sparse settlement offer little sign of the danger ashore. An unnatural sickness spreading through Teldrassil has driven the plant life into a frenzy. Druids and researchers from Dolanaar send travelers to gather seeds and kill the aggressive creatures before the corruption spreads deeper into the forest.

Oakenscowl, once a noble timberling, spreads corruption from a cave on Lake Al'Ameth's southern bank. A gargantuan tumor has swollen his body, and other timberlings lash out at anyone who approaches. The woodland spirits have lost their balance, and the Cenarion Circle faces an urgent test: can the rot around the lake be diagnosed and treated, and can Teldrassil's unblessed creation be sustained?
